item.title: Dai Ni Ongakushitsu e Youkoso!!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: WHEEL
  • 発売日: 2012-08-31
  • スコア: 6.81/10 (23 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 第二音楽室へようこそっ!!
  • 英語名: Dai Ni Ongakushitsu e Youkoso!!

あらすじ

Masato returned to Japan after 3 years in Vienna with his parents. Immediately after his first day of class at Yonamori Gakuen, his osananajimi Kana grabbed his hand and dragged him to the second music room in the old school building. She welcomed him to the music club, which everyone in the school dismisses as just a group of weird kids playing together. What will happen to his new school life?

あらすじ

Who said that first?

Hino, the captain of the student council, always writes a big circle on the paper when she approves. Hino writes Maru (circle). That’s why it is called “Hinomaru” order!

Shuuhei, the main character, has started working as a director of the student council just recently…

[From ErogeShop]

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: WHEEL
  • 発売日: 2009-06-25
  • スコア: 6.95/10 (63 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ～パンツを見せること、それが……～大宇宙の誇り
  • 英語名: Pantsu o Miseru Koto, Sore ga… Daiuchuu no Hokori

别名

  • ~Panties o Miserukoto

あらすじ

A meteor struck Mamoru when he was a kid, but he didn’t get injured at all. That’s why he was called “Miracle Meteor Boy”. Seven years later, two beautiful girls surrounded by noble aura suddenly captured Mamoru and he was taken to a strange place. Yes, it’s inside a spaceship and there he can see even more beautiful girls with their panties exposed as if it’s a matter of course…
